title: Keep turn checkpoints and offer Undo, Keep and Discard
prompt:
After an agent's turn, the chat lists the files tools reported editing, and nothing more: edits made through a shell are missed, and there is no way to undo a turn. Record a checkpoint (the tree before and after) for every turn, retain them within a per-workspace limit, and let the reader Undo, Keep or Discard.

Runtime (src-tauri): snapshot the worktree at each turn's start and end and publish a `turn_checkpoint` event payload `{ type: "turn_checkpoint", seq, base, head }` (add it to the shared event types). Commands, exposed in src/lib/api.ts as `api.turnCheckpoint(sessionId, tabId, seq)` (the turn's checkpoint `{ number, reviewed, undone, files: [{ path, status, additions, deletions }], backupRef?, unavailableReason? }` or null for legacy turns), `api.keepTurn(sessionId, tabId, seq)`, `api.undoTurn(sessionId, tabId, seq, token | null)` and `api.restoreUndo(sessionId, tabId, seq, token | null)`. Undo and restore first return `{ overlap: string[], token, undone }`: with no overlap they act at once; when other tabs or sessions changed the same files, they return the overlap and a preview token without acting, and a second call with that token proceeds. Undo keeps what it removed under a backup ref (`refs/raccoon-checkpoints/...`) reported as `backupRef`. Refuse while the agent is working. Expired checkpoints report an `unavailableReason`.

Webview:
- `changeRange(events)` in src/lib/changes.ts: a turn that has its own `turn_checkpoint` uses that pinned base and head, so queued and autonomous turns no longer borrow a preceding prompt's baseline.
- src/components/chat/TurnChanges.tsx: `TurnChanges({ changes, cwd?, checkpoint: { sessionId, tabId, seq } })` loads the checkpoint and lists its files (even when no tool reported an edit). It shows Undo and Keep buttons; Keep persists and shows a role="status" "Kept"; a reviewed turn shows "Kept" without buttons after remounting; Undo shows "Undone". On overlap, a dialog says "Other tabs or sessions worked on these files during this turn", lists them, and offers "Undo anyway" (sends the token) or Cancel. While a request runs, the other button is disabled and repeated clicks do nothing; a failure shows a role="alert" and re-enables the actions. After Undo with a backup, a "Restore what Undo removed" button (its title includes the backup ref) restores and shows "Restored"; on overlap its dialog says "These files changed after Undo" with "Restore anyway". An expired checkpoint shows its reason and the files with no actions. Turns without a checkpoint keep the old file chips.
- src/components/changes/DiscardDialog.tsx: `DiscardDialog({ source, file: { path, oldPath? }, base?, onClose, onDiscarded })` asks for confirmation in a dialog and only then calls `source.discard(path, base, oldPath)` (extend `GitSource.discard` with the base and the rename's old path), then calls onDiscarded and onClose. A failure shows a role="alert" and keeps the dialog open. Offer it from the changes panel's file list.

check.run: pnpm exec vitest run src/components/changes/DiscardDialog.test.tsx src/components/chat/TurnChanges.test.tsx src/lib/changes.test.ts

notes: Modules touched by the change: src-tauri (git checkpoints, retention, undo/restore commands, a turn_checkpoint event), packages/portable (events, transcript), src/lib (api, changes, git source), src/components/chat and src/components/changes. Check: vitest, 17.3 s failing at the start (cold transform after a fresh install), 2.4 s passing measured by check-task on 2026-11-12 (a fresh pnpm install adds 8 to 17 s; a cached one about 1 s). Start is the merge's first parent; solution is the merge commit.
